images.prompt: A friendly picture-book scene of coming home from a trip: a young woman with a backpack and a rolling suitcase covered in travel stickers arrives at a German train station platform, waving to a friend; behind her a train, a bench with a pigeon, and her small dog wearing a tiny travel hat peeking out of a basket on the suitcase. The stickers, signs and train destination are blank.

A tidy, proud young man stands in a freshly tidied room holding a broom, everything in perfect order — except his cat, which has just knocked a whole stack of books off the shelf behind him and looks innocent.

A small dog asleep on a sofa, wet from swimming, with a towel half over it and a muddy trail of paw prints leading from the open door across the floor to the sofa; a woman stands at the door holding the lead, laughing.

An old armchair moment: a grandmother shows a young girl an old photo album on her lap; floating above them, like a thought bubble, a small scene of the grandmother as a little girl with a big dog. The photos are blank pictures, no writing.

A busy birthday moment: a man hands a wrapped present to an old woman, a girl gives flowers to a smiling teacher, and a boy gives a bone to a dog — three people each giving something to someone, side by side.

A woman on her way to work on a city bus, holding a paper bag from the bakery; through the bus window we see a post office and a doctor's door going by, and on the seat next to her a dog sits upright like a passenger, looking out of the window. Signs are blank, no writing.

In a clothes shop, a tall man tries on a jacket that is clearly far too small: the sleeves stop at his elbows and it will not close over his belly; he looks down at it, puzzled. Next to him a cheerful young saleswoman with dark hair and a natural skin tone holds up a thumbs-up. Only these two people.

Two people and a dog standing side by side on grass: a grandfather hands a red ball to a small boy, and the small boy at the same time hands a bone to a happy dog. Clear, simple, all three standing on the ground.

A small town street crossing seen from the front: a woman comes out of a cinema door eating popcorn, a man walks into a bakery, and a boy rides his bike towards a doctor's door with a plaster on his nose; a lost-looking tourist with a big map asks a policeman the way while the policeman points in two directions at once. Signs and doors are blank, no writing.

An old man and a young woman sit on a park bench feeding pigeons; the old man has a long white beard that reaches the ground and a tiny bird has built a nest in it, as if he has been sitting there for years, while the young woman checks her wristwatch.

One street, four weathers: a single row of houses where the left part has bright sun and a man in sunglasses, the next part rain with a woman under an umbrella, then snow with a child building a snowman, then strong wind blowing a man's hat away; a cat sits in the middle looking confused.

A very big friendly dog and a very small cat standing side by side, measured against a height chart drawn as plain lines without numbers; the tiny cat stands on a stack of books to look taller, very proud.

A woman in a clothes shop holding up two almost identical dresses, one in each hand, looking from one to the other undecided; her bored partner sits on a stool with a pile of shopping bags, and the shop assistant points at a third, identical dress.

A green front door at night with a doorbell; nobody is outside except a small hedgehog standing on tiptoe reaching up to ring the bell, while a sleepy man in pyjamas peeks out through the letterbox flap. No text, no numbers, no labels anywhere in the picture.

A young woman at a café table in an Italian old town square writing a postcard, a big pizza in front of her, a small Roman fountain behind; a pigeon sits on the edge of her plate eating the crust. The postcard is blank.
